title: Slices: content-free, live-rendering review model
description: Rebuilds the review model so it stores no code — only where to look and what to say. Adds the anchor engine, union diff, slice model/store/capture, CLI slice commands, comment anchoring, desktop IPC/preload live rendering, and session→slice migration.

steps.title: Anchor engine (the foundation)
steps.body: Drift-following anchors: a line-range hint plus a fingerprint of the line text (the truth). resolveAnchor re-finds the text in live content, following inserts/removals or going outdated. Pure-JS so it runs in node and the renderer.

callouts.body: The resolver: try the hint, then scan outward for an exact content match, else outdated.

steps.title: Union diff mode
steps.body: old side = merge-base(base, HEAD), new side = the working tree, so a slice renders every branch change vs its fork point, committed AND uncommitted, in one call.

steps.title: Slice model, store & capture
steps.body: The content-free model. captureSlice resolves the file scope from the union diff and fingerprints each callout against live content — no diff content is ever stored.

steps.title: CLI: slice commands + deprecated session alias
steps.body: slice save/clear/migrate; session save delegates with a deprecation notice so existing agent scripts keep working.

steps.title: Comments: anchor + derived committability
steps.body: Comments gain a fingerprint anchor and a posted-binding column; isCommittable derives GitHub-postability live from HEAD.

steps.title: Desktop: live slice rendering (IPC + preload)
steps.body: git:listChangedFiles/getDiff resolve a slice to a live union (or branch, read-only) context filtered to its files; slices:* CRUD + watcher; preload api.slices.

steps.title: Migration + docs
steps.body: slice-migrate converts legacy frozen sessions (content dropped, callouts to fingerprint-less anchors), moving originals aside. Docs/skill updated to slices.
